estimand: The validation-selected nonzero CIAV verification budget's confirmatory utility gain, budget compliance, and action-regret behavior under identical predecision information.

arms.implementation_contract: No-verification diagnostic control used only for paired utility contrasts; it cannot resolve the active-verification budget.
At most one causally available verification action per episode with truth revealed only after the action endpoint.
At most two causally available verification actions per episode under the identical action and observation ontology.
At most four causally available verification actions per episode with every query and cost recorded.

information_contract: All budgets receive identical predecision beliefs, available verification actions, public ontology, outcome models, and post-action truth timing per unit.
budget_contract: Non-query compute, model parameters, validation-search trials, and episode count are identical; the only arm difference is the preregistered maximum verification count and incurred cost.
claim_boundary: Resolves only ciav_action_budget and cannot prove CIAV efficacy, resolve another binding, validate Gate B, or authorize a seven-operator ablation.
